Container.Name: nas-audio-finder
Container.Overview: Local audio metadata search with quarantine/restore, saved presets, persistent results and history, daily schedules, health checks, rich metadata filters, and exact/acoustic duplicate candidates. Includes optional lossless authenticity screening with evidence and same-folder context for isolated warnings. Load the release Docker archive before applying this template. No browser audio playback.

Config.Name: Music library
Config.Description: Local Unraid folder containing music. Read/write is required for deletion.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Persistent duration cache; use your appdata share.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user; change if your library uses another owner.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Daily scan schedules use UTC. The browser displays file dates in its own local time zone.

Config.Name: History limit
Config.Description: Maximum scan histories retained (1-1000). Quarantine records are independent.

Config.Name: Optional web password
Config.Description: Optional Basic Auth password; username admin. Use only on a trusted LAN or behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.
